+"""Unicode tokens inside a value (the tokenizer is the hot path)."""
+
+from lamina.lexer.core import Token
+
+
+def scan_unicode(value: str, line: int, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> list[Token]:
+    """Split value into unicode words, separated by ':' or whitespace."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(value)
+    tokens: list[Token] = []
+    current_word: list[str] = []
+    start = 1
+    for column, ch in enumerate(value, start=1):
+        if ch.isspace() or ch == ':':
+            if current_word:
+                tokens.append(Token("WORD", "".join(current_word), line, start))
+                current_word = []
+            continue
+        if not current_word:
+            start = column
+        current_word.append(ch)
+    if current_word:
+        tokens.append(Token("WORD", "".join(current_word), line, start))
+    return tokens

+from lamina.lexer.unicode import scan_unicode
+
+
+def test_unicode_words():
+    assert [t.value for t in scan_unicode("a:b c", 1)] == ["a", "b", "c"]
+
+
+def test_unicode_columns():
+    assert [t.column for t in scan_unicode("ab:cd", 3)] == [1, 4]
+
+
+def test_unicode_empty():
+    assert scan_unicode("", 1) == []
